newsitem.title: POLAND: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR POLAND V ENGLAND WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR POLAND V ENGLAND WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Teams for Saturday's World Cup European group two qualifying match between Poland and England at the Slaski Stadium:

Poland - 1-Andrzej Wozniak; 2-Radoslaw Kaluzny, 3-Jacek Zielinski, 4-Marek Jozwiak, 5-Tomasz Waldoch, 7-Krzysztof Bukalski, 10-Piotr Nowak, 6-Slawimir Majak, 8-Adam Ledworn, 9-Andrzej Juskowiak, 11-Jacek Dembinski
England - 1-David Seaman; 2-Gary Neville, 3-Sol Campbell, 5-Gareth Southgate, 4-Paul Ince, 6-Graeme Le Saux, 7-David Beckham, 8-Paul Gascoigne, 9-Alan Shearer, 10-Teddy Sheringham, 11-Robert Lee
